title: Assisted Reproductive Technology Success Rates at Public and Private Centres
what_it_is: Assisted Reproductive Technology Success Rates at Public and Private Centres

sections.label: ART success rates by age
sections.summary: ART success rates decline with age, dropping after maternal age 35, with public and private centre rates and 2013-2015 averages given.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The success rates for Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) decline with increasing age and, in fact, drops precipitously after the maternal age of 35.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For public centres, success rates are 29.5% for women below 30, 27.1% for women from 30 to 35, 16.1% for women from 36 to 40, and 6.1% for women above 40.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: A similar trend is observed in the private centres, where the success rates stand at 26.7% for women below 30, 24.6% for women from 30 to 35, 17.3% for women from 36 to 40, and 6.7% for women above 40.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Our clinical data also shows that, overall, from 2013 to 2015, the average ART success rates are 21.3% at the public centres and 19% at the private centres.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The ART co-funding was enhanced in 2013, along with the MediSave withdrawal for ACP that was also enhanced in 2013.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have been monitoring the average bill sizes and we will review if the average bill sizes rise such that it significantly affects affordability.

sections.label: No decision on age limit
sections.summary: Success rates drop drastically after age 35, so the age limit will not be extended at this point.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As shown from statistics, the success rates drop drastically after age 35; for women above 40, it is at about 6%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Therefore, we will continue to see what the success rates are before we consider whether we can extend.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But at this point in time, there is no decision to extend this age limit.
